Jamestown Man Arrested for Alleged Trespassing, Narcotics Possession
By StaffReport1 - Press Release,
5 hours agoJAMESTOWN, CA — “At approximately 3:20 a.m. on Saturday, August 23, officers responded to Walmart for a report of a man refusing to leave the store, and store official requested the man, later identified as 33 year old Christian Gonzalez, to be trespassed. A Sonora PD officer located Christian near the entrance of Walmart. The Sonora PD officer was advised by dispatch that Christian was on Tuolumne County probation. Christian was detained and searched, and a Sonora PD officer located methamphetamine on Christian’s person. Dispatch advised the Sonora PD officer that Christian had more than 2 prior convictions for possession of ‘hard drugs,’ which enhances the new drug charge to a felony under Prop 36. Christian was booked at the county jail without incident.”
